attribution.processing: Converted by scripts/convert-aij-case-e.py from the AIJ Case E workbook: all 16 wind directions transcribed to JSON in the workbook's full-scale meters, the after-construction results selected into `speed` with the before-construction column retained per probe, direction headers read as meteorological FROM bearings, and the tabulated inflow retained alongside the published alpha=0.25 profile. The already-normalized velocity ratios are not divided again.
attribution.disclaimer: These derived files were created and processed independently for AeroFlow. The Architectural Institute of Japan (AIJ) does not guarantee their quality, accuracy, completeness, or suitability for any particular purpose.

coordinates.origin: Center of the 500 m x 500 m reproduced area shared by the workbook probes and DXF; source +X is east and +Y is north.

measurement.uRef: Workbook velocity ratio normalized by inflow velocity at 15.9 m. For lattice-unit mapping, 3.91704789288 m/s is derived from the published alpha=0.25 profile and workbook UR=7.8 m/s at ZR=250 m; the already-normalized measurements are not divided again.

inflow.note: Wind-tunnel validation profile: alpha=0.25 (Yoshie et al. 2007; Hagbo and Giljarhus 2022). Normalized to Uref at 15.9 m.

sourceInflow.note: Inflow worksheet transcribed verbatim; retained separately from the V15 alpha=0.25 BC.

notes: Results (After Construction) is selected because the official CAD contains the 60 m tower.
Results (Before Construction) is retained in every probe's speedByVariant field.
Direction headers N..NNW are interpreted as meteorological FROM bearings clockwise from north.
The DXF and workbook use full-scale meters; no model-to-full-scale multiplication is applied.
